Otherwise drain keeps running and the report says \\\"no landing changed the outcome\\\" (new `Report.outcome_changed` field and a display line). The source check is not asked in that case.\\n\\n**2. Source check of all page text.** `Athena::check_study_text`, in `athena-core/src/pin.rs`, makes one model call per study, run as the verifier role with the verifier's model, cap and timeout, and read-only tools only.\\n- The core pins the source at the study's `pin.json` sha and fails if the pin resolves to a different commit.\\n- The source is mounted read-only beside the page text.\\n- The checker reports contradicted and omitted statements with file and source lines, and lists the files it read.\\n- It fails if there is any problem, an unparseable report, a pin failure, text over 400,000 bytes, or a covered file the checker did not list as read.\\n- Every file in a study directory is page text except `pin.json` and `validation.json` (`STRUCTURAL_FILES`). A file added later is checked automatically.\\n\\n`RealSteps::check_page` runs the model-free `model_contradictions` floor first and fails without a model call if the floor fails. It then runs the model check on each study.\\n\\n**Budget.** A new `Steps::check_cap` is the verifier cap times the study count. It must fit the budget before the check starts, or drain stops as \\\"budget spent\\\". `Check` gained a `cost` field, which is added to `spent_usd` whether the check passes or fails.\\n\\nI updated `Stop::TargetMet` docs, the module docs, `athena drain --help`, the README, a new decision D100 in `docs/decisions.md` (alternatives, all page text, the floor) and `CHANGELOG.md`.\\n\\nTests are in `tests/drain.rs` and in `tests/common/mod.rs`, where the fake agent now answers source-check calls.
